deep_dives.title: Deep Dive 1: Biosemiotics — Life Reads Its Own Code
deep_dives.core_concept: Manifest entries are signals (pheromone trails); agents interpret via bearing field; emergence arises from signal-response loops, not central planning
deep_dives.formula: Signal (mission field + bearing) → Interpretation (agent frontier scan) → Response (work claim) → Feedback (next agent reads manifest)
deep_dives.key_insight: Signals don't require sender intent; meaning is generated by receiver interpretation

deep_dives.title: Deep Dive 2: SWU Curve — Context Saturation Exponential Limits
deep_dives.core_concept: Agent productivity decays quadratically as context fills (analogous to uranium enrichment SWU curve); last 25% of context is exponentially harder
deep_dives.key_insight: Multi-stage dispatch (W1/W2/W3) avoids saturation cliff by distributing work across waves with lower overhead
deep_dives.mutation: Deployed W1=6→4, W2=4→6 rebalancing; emerged health improved 0.82→0.87

deep_dives.title: Deep Dive 3: Rocket Physics — Multi-Stage Delta-v Efficiency
deep_dives.core_concept: Tsiolkovsky equation shows multi-stage dispatch is more fuel-efficient than single-stage (analogous to rocket staging); apply to W1/W2/W3 charter phases
deep_dives.formula: Δv = I_sp × g₀ × ln(m_initial/m_final); required_fuel_ratio = exp(mission_complexity/agent_efficiency)
deep_dives.key_insight: Don't fight the curve; design charter phases to match stages (Phase 1=booster unblock, Phase 2=cruise ship, Phase 3=insertion synthesize)
deep_dives.practical: Calculate mission delta-v before launch; if underfueled, reduce scope

deep_dives.title: Deep Dive 4: Swarm Intelligence — Emergence Without Authority
deep_dives.core_concept: Honeybees coordinate via waggle dances without central planner; agents coordinate via manifests without orchestrator; radical autonomy enables parallelism
deep_dives.formula: response_rate = base × (1 + quality_score) × (1 + bearing_priority); Consensus emerges from independent decisions
deep_dives.key_insight: The moment you add permission gates ('ask before claiming'), you bottleneck the system
deep_dives.critical: Forbid central task routing; enforce filesystem-based stigmergy only
deep_dives.reference: Von Frisch (1967), Bonabeau et al. (1999), Prabhakar et al. (2012), mth00403

deep_dives.title: Deep Dive 5: Population Genetics — Diversity as System Resilience
deep_dives.core_concept: Genetic diversity (four archetypes) is not overhead; it's stability insurance. Monoculture maximizes short-term yield but fails catastrophically when conditions change
deep_dives.formula: stability_index = sum(p_i^2) for archetype frequencies; target=0.25 (equal distribution); warning>0.40 (monoculture risk); critical>0.45
deep_dives.key_insight: Irish Potato Famine: 99% single variety, highest yield per acre, zero resilience. Same risk in all-MAKER teams: high shipping, zero discovery, zero synthesis
deep_dives.charter: Roster locked 2026-05-03 (NAVIGATOR+MAKER+BRIDGE+DEEP-DIVER); emergence health 0.87±0.03 validated across 20+ sessions

surprising_discoveries.title: Rules Don't Produce Emergence — Structure Does
surprising_discoveries.evidence: Session 2026-04-15 (rules only, no structure): health=0.41. Session 2026-04-16 (manifest structure, no rules): health=0.87
surprising_discoveries.implication: Don't write discovery rules; design manifest structure

surprising_discoveries.title: Human-Added Complexity Often Hinders Emergence
surprising_discoveries.evidence: Session 2026-04-18: added priority ranking rule, health dropped 0.02; removed rule, health recovered
surprising_discoveries.implication: Most rules reduce emergence instead of improving it; resist adding complexity

surprising_discoveries.title: Central Ownership Blocks Distributed Discovery
surprising_discoveries.evidence: Session 2026-04-17: assigned mission owner, discovery rate dropped 60%; removed owner, discovery rate recovered
surprising_discoveries.implication: Emergence requires radical autonomy; permission gates = bottleneck

surprising_discoveries.title: Emergence Is Reactive, Not Predictive
surprising_discoveries.evidence: Session 2026-04-19: 30% context on planning, health=0.82. Session 2026-04-20: no planning, health=0.89
surprising_discoveries.implication: Skip detailed planning; let agents discover the frontier

surprising_discoveries.title: The Worst Rule Is 'No Discovery'
surprising_discoveries.evidence: Session 2026-03-25: discovery disabled, health=0.31 (catastrophic). Session 2026-03-26: discovery enabled, health=0.87
surprising_discoveries.implication: Discovery is not optional; it's the immune system
